This site is in early testing with our local community — it exists to share the vision clearly and open a real conversation, not to present a finished organisation. Your honest feedback is genuinely welcome.

Who we are

METARA exists to help discover, design and implement the patterns that already sustain life — and apply them to how we build economies, communities and ecosystems.

Life has demonstrated through billions of years of evolution that resilient systems emerge through cooperation, diversity, specialization, and interconnectedness. A healthy forest thrives not because every tree competes for the most resources — but because countless relationships continuously create more life than they consume. METARA is built on that same principle.

"To cultivate a global network of thriving regenerative communities that demonstrate how humanity can flourish in partnership with nature."

    METARA Re:Source

    Tap to explore

    METARA Re:Source

    A community-owned circular economy system, coordinated through the local cooperative. Members earn Resource Credits for recovering materials — cans, glass, plastic, organic waste, e-waste — that would otherwise be discarded, and redeem them for products, services and support drawn from what the network has produced. Waste becomes an economic input rather than a cost.

    Tap to return
  • Seed · Awaiting Fertile Ground

    METARA Repair Culture

    Tap to explore

    METARA Repair Culture

    A decentralised network connecting broken items with repair knowledge, idle tools with people who need them, and learners with mentors. Starting lightweight — repair cafés, tool-and-skill swaps, community build days — it grows into a shared registry of regional capability: less dependence on distant supply chains, and skills that circulate instead of disappearing between generations.

A different kind of branch
The Cooperative

Member-governed, from the start

The METARA Cooperative is not owned by METARA. It is being incubated by METARA Living Solutions, which serves as founding administrator during this early phase — coordinating logistics, structure, and governance design. As the Cooperative matures, this role is designed to deliberately step back, handing full control to elected member governance.

Founding

3–9 core members

Stability before expansion. Vision, governance structure, and financial transparency are established.

Expansion

12–36 members

Designing circulation of value — money, knowledge, skills, and relationships flowing through the ecosystem.

Ecosystem

50+ members

Decentralised execution, centralised values. Many projects operate independently, aligned by shared principles.

This roadmap, and the incubation arrangement itself, will have its own dedicated page as the Cooperative takes shape.

How it works
Circular economy

Waste is not worthless

Waste is accumulated embodied energy, labour, materials, knowledge and ecological extraction that has become disconnected from a useful cycle. METARA exists to close those cycles — and reward the people who do it.

↻

Collect

Resources are recovered from waste streams across the local economy

◈

Credit

Members earn Resource Credits for every regenerative contribution

⬡

Produce

The cooperative transforms materials into products, food, energy and services

◎

Circulate

Credits flow locally, strengthening the bioregional economy with every cycle

"A living economy where contribution to the commons becomes the foundation of prosperity."

METARA Circular Economy

The first pilot is launching now in Plettenberg Bay — connecting a small cluster of local businesses into a food and soil loop: coffee waste to mushroom substrate, spent substrate to compost, compost to vegetables, vegetables back to the café. Simple. Proven. Ready to expand.

Taproot · CHAPTER II – Identity
Values:Collaboration, Regeneration, Transparency
Principles:Systems Thinking

Every culture has answered "Who are we?" with a story — and that story shapes how people treat each other and the world. Today's dominant narrative, of a vast indifferent cosmos and an insignificant human life within it, has made disrespect toward each other and toward nature easy to justify. MEDNA answers differently: it reclaims the significance of a human life and the harmony it can create — within a person, between people, and with the living world around them.

"Change the story, change our lives."

This is why MEDNA sits at the root rather than the surface. It isn't a slogan — it's the standard every METARA decision is measured against: does this strengthen the organism, or weaken it? Every project, partnership and failure feeds back into MEDNA, refining it consciously over time — never randomly, always toward greater coherence.

Feeder Roots · CHAPTER IV – Nourishment
METARA Charity – raises & distributes funds from outside the organism
+ future feeder roots

Reach outward into surrounding soil – donors, sponsors, the wider community – and draw resources inward, the way fine lateral roots feed a tree from soil beyond its own tissue.
